Enterprise offering explicitly includes 'zarządzanie Master Data (MDM/PIM)'.

interpretation: The MDM claim is not an over-claim about OmegaCode's capabilities. The failure was introduced because the new fresh PPWR evidence used in Run G does not contain MDM, while hook_grounding validates claims only against the selected evidence_content.

rejected_fixes.reason: Would remove a factually supported capability merely to fit the substituted source.
Would be a rule-level precision loss and is unnecessary.

recommended_fix.description: Keep the fresh dated PPWR source for recency and add a current OmegaCode capability source that explicitly supports MDM/PIM to the evidence bundle used by hook grounding. Do not weaken the rule and do not delete a supported claim.
